# Owner RA-3C QA Phase B V1 adjudication — authorize separate QA V2 with business gates UNCHANGED

**Independent first actual candidate run independently reviewed:** [PR #48 results](https://github.com/gloweaseco-leo/VRAE/pull/48#issuecomment-6815747731), frozen QA source `fa645b58549dfd21a6b80656d403f672b790acd8`, original 64-case JUnit Python3.11/3.13 each **11 PASS /53 FAIL /0 ERROR/SKIP/XFAIL**. Original input/test Git blobs and all raw RED results must be retained unchanged. Feature SHA `6a7a3d3aa5f4341059b04567157f7fc58d6bf6d2` was the tested target. Accepted main has since moved to docs-only RA3D P0 `60dbe1e1acfc84ad0849e84f3abe3712ad8ebccd`; feature PR47 will receive a *separate minimal authorized P1 mobile banner font fix*, not an interpretation/guard semantics change.

**Owner adjudication of M01–M08 and versioned QA resolution:** All 8 previous issues are *contract/representation gates*, not 8 production bugs. Frozen V1 remains valid historical rejection evidence, not valid 64-positive acceptance.
- **M01** externally pinned valid request metadata and held version hashes from an independent Owner-authorized fixture are allowed, never generated from attacked JSON/producer output.
- **M02 (52 V1 failures):** Product contract deliberately accepts only exact safe fixed `editorial.PROPOSALS` pending human review. Unsupported arbitrary HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED prose (even with valid guard IDs) must **reject, not become report facts or displayed text**. Original independent inputs remain required **negative controls with explicit `REPORT_UNSUPPORTED_PROSE`**. Separately pinned independently source-derived, **admissible** supported prose/guard requests may be used as POSITIVE controls for each unchanged business intent. Do not replace strings in the adapter, auto-approve, pre-filter or rebind incoming untrusted model text. Do not count a refused request as a successful report. New test/protocol version only.
- **M07 (1 V1 failure):** submitted `NOT_RUN` guard must be rejected; a separately pinned truly empty `guard_inputs=[]`, matching `expected_guard_refs=[]` is the admissible 0-issue coverage control. Preserve and assert both outcomes, never silently drop the original submitted guard.
- **M08:** duplicate captured target must yield **one** issue only when *each asserted native finding/citation used by the report has a verified binding*. Original missing-second-binding request must reject; separately pinned source-complete dual-guard request must succeed with one deduped issue. No bypassing provenance to force dedup.
- **M03 language:** actual `<html lang>` is source, mutate actual returned HTML bytes and require native load integrity refusal; don't invent language JSON field.
- **M04 evidence:** real nested `issues[*].fact_claim.fact.source/citation` and bridge pointers, never flat fake evidence; mutate original native field and independently replay with caller pins, including outer reseal attempts.
- **M05 objective text/ref collections:** read-only projection from actual `issues[*].fact_claim` and `positive_source_claims`, preserving literal strings/refs and auditable JSON pointers, no new report fields or fabricated lists.
- **M06 no score:** negative membership check of true native report and visible text; no unrelated null placeholder, no false revenue or rankings.

**Authorize `OWNER_ADJUDICATED_RA3C_QA_V2` design/test source as a NEW explicitly versioned test and separately held fixture/protocol with a complete v1→v2 change manifest**, retaining all **original 64 oracle IDs and substantive business/security/UX requirements**. Distinguish original 53 expected *invalid-request denials* from admissible source-backed *positive report results*. Preserve original 64 V1 test and original 14 inputs, old 11/53 JUnit, original PhaseA RED, and no historical SHA manipulation. The V2 test must include at least 64 original business acceptance objectives (zero dropped/xfail/skips) and companion negative input rejection controls for M02/M07/M08; do not claim V1 is now GREEN. New source/input blob hashes and exact own QA-only paths; do not modify Codex2 production or unapproved main. The valid fixture cannot just copy Codex2 tests or report outputs; derive from independently verified existing accepted EvidencePack/Guard refs and explicitly held copy vocabulary accepted as *proposal*, not fact.

**Independent visual gate from real Chromium** is a confirmed deficiency: 375px private banner 11px below 12px frozen F04. Owner authorized Codex2 alone to fix CSS in PR47 and rerun all exact SHA/CI. **Do not lower 12px or reuse Codex2 screenshots**. You may prepare V2 source + test harness in own worktree meanwhile, but final full V2 execution/browsing must target Codex2's **new SHA** after patch, with original 64-case V1 truthful classification and genuine 375px/1280px independently captured screenshots, evidence clicks and no external requests. Report all actual pass/fail/error/skip, JUnit, member Git blob SHA, and proof of source-level/UX boundaries.

**Neither PR47 nor PR48 may merge yet.** Next Owner acceptance: RA3C exact new feature SHA, 4 hosted CI, 64+ actual independent V2 objectives and 12px privacy banner, then feature merge → QA branch latest-main integration/4 new CI → Owner QA merge. RA3D Phase0 docs PR50 has merged but **RA3D code remains NO_GO**. Human Gold 0/26 quality unmeasured, real models/sites/spend/client share still NO_GO.
